title: #295 Technology and Life
prompt: Technology has made the world a better place to live. To what extent do you agree with this statement？

faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.

faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.

modelPlan.focus: evaluate the extent to which technology has improved the world by examining its positive impacts and potential drawbacks, then conclude with a balanced perspective.
keyArguments: Technology has significantly improved daily life through advancements in communication, information access, and efficiency.
Despite its benefits, technology has also introduced challenges such as the digital divide and potential over-reliance on modern amenities.
